decisions.reason: The color-matching and ICC workflow is already owned by the print color specification; it does not alter the basket-weave design attributes. The basket-specific scale and mustard-edge changes already have a same-message MODIFY.

The shared color-production workflow does not change the zebra design's palette, stripe, or border requirements. Its target-specific black-border change is already represented by a same-message MODIFY.

The requirement to deliver production-ready artwork remains unchanged. The ICC and CMYK handling details belong to the separate print color specification and do not replace or narrow the required output.

The source confirms a general color-matching workflow but does not establish a new terracotta-pareo design value. The referenced Pantone value is not present in the supplied message text, and the existing interior and border requirements remain valid.
The source confirms a general color-matching workflow but does not change the mustard pareo's interior or border attributes. No exact replacement Pantone value is available in the supplied evidence.
